name: What is backflow prevention and why is it important for businesses?

mainEntity.name: What is backflow prevention and why is it important for businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Backflow prevention is critical for businesses to protect their potable water supply from contamination. It involves devices that prevent water from flowing backward into the main water lines, which can happen due to pressure changes. In commercial settings, cross-connections can exist between potable water and non-potable sources, such as irrigation systems, fire suppression systems, or industrial processes. Regular testing and maintenance of backflow prevention devices are often mandated by local health departments to safeguard public health and ensure your business remains compliant with water quality regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Backflow prevention stops contaminated water from entering the clean water supply, crucial for businesses to protect public health and maintain regulatory compliance.
